slides.label: Kinda chic
slides.title: Knowing when every vet's license renews without digging through a drawer.
slides.body: Bonus points for the techs' certifications too.

slides.label: Kinda chic
slides.title: Having the DEA registration date written down somewhere besides the frame on the wall.
slides.body: Reading it off the wall during an inspection is not the move.

slides.label: Kinda chic
slides.title: Renewing the business license in November.
slides.body: Not the week it lapses. Not after the city mails a second notice.

slides.label: Kinda chic
slides.title: One list of every license, permit and policy.
slides.body: Not 'renewals FINAL (2).xlsx' on the front desk computer.

slides.label: Also kinda chic
slides.title: Hearing about an expiration from a reminder, not an inspector.
